title: Fever fps+pvp
description: This PvP + FPS modpack is designed to maximize performance while keeping gameplay clean and responsive. It reduces lag, boosts FPS, and adds useful PvP enhancements.
body:
![Fever fps+pvp](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ee137bcd6ad923cf857359a53cfe4e1092b23127.jpeg)
# 🔥Fever FPS+PvP

Fever FPS+PvP is a hyper-optimized Minecraft modpack built for one purpose: insane FPS and competitive PvP performance. Designed for both low-end PCs and high-end systems, it uses powerful optimization mods like Sodium, Lithium, Starlight, and more to squeeze out every frame possible.

Whether you're playing survival, PvP, or creative, you’ll experience higher FPS, faster load times, reduced input delay, and almost zero stutter.
## 🚀Built to Break FPS Limits

Say goodbye to lag spikes and unstable performance. Fever FPS+PvP is tuned for maximum FPS stability, even in heavy fights, large worlds, and multiplayer servers.

Every system in Minecraft — rendering, chunk loading, and ticking — is optimized to deliver consistent high FPS and smooth gameplay.
## PvP Performance Advantage

This modpack is not just about FPS — it’s built for competitive PvP dominance.

It improves:

- Input response time
- Combat smoothness
- Visual clarity
- Target tracking

Giving you a real advantage in duels, servers, and fast-paced fights.
## ✨OptiFine-Like Features Without Performance Loss
 
Enjoy essential features similar to OptiFine, including:

- Zoom
- Connected textures
- Shader support

All while maintaining high FPS and low memory usage.

⚠️ OptiFine is NOT included in this modpack.
## 🚀 Built to Break FPS Limits

Say goodbye to lag spikes and unstable performance. Fever FPS+PvP is tuned for maximum FPS stability, even in heavy fights, large worlds, and multiplayer servers.

Every system in Minecraft — rendering, chunk loading, and ticking — is optimized to deliver consistent high FPS and smooth gameplay.
## ⚡ Lean, Clean, and Fast

### No unnecessary content mods. No clutter.

Fever FPS+PvP is designed to stay lightweight and efficient, ensuring maximum performance at all times. It works perfectly on:

- PvP servers
- Survival worlds
- Singleplayer gameplay

Even menus and UI are optimized for speed and responsiveness.
## 🧠 Instant Responsiveness Everywhere
### Everything feels faster and smoother:
- Faster world loading
- Instant inventory response
- Smooth animations
- Reduced lag spikes

With low input delay, you gain a real edge in PvP, parkour, and movement-based gameplay.
## 🧩 Fabric-Powered for Speed
### Built on the lightweight Fabric mod loader, this modpack is:
- Fast
- Lightweight
- Highly customizable

You can add your own mods or keep it minimal for maximum FPS boost.
